test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: McMahon line is a line which separates China and which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Arunachal Pradesh**

 
 
• **​Northeastern **India's **Arunachal Pradesh**, or **"Land of Dawn-Lit Mountains"**, is a state. **On February 20, 198**7, it became a state after being created from the former** North-East Frontier Agency (NEFA)** region.
 
• It shares a **southern **border with the states of **Assam** and **Nagaland**. At the **McMahon **Line, it shares a disputed **border **with **China **in the **north **as well as** international boundaries** with **Bhutan **and **Myanmar **in the **west **and **east**, respectively.
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh's** state capital is **Itanagar**. The **Seven Sister **States of **Northeast** India's **Arunachal Prades**h are the largest geographically.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://www.cheggindia.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/gk-46032-mcmahon-line-v1.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The population of **Arunachal Pradesh** is **1,382,611**, and its area is **83,743 **square kilometres** (32,333 sq mi)**. It is a state with a variety of different ethnic groups, with a concentration of **Monpa **people in the **west**, **Tani **people in the **centre**, **Mishmi **and **Tai **people in the **east**, and **Naga **people in the **southeast**. In the state, there are about **100 **minor **tribes **and **26 **major **tribes**.
 
• The state's major tribes are the **Adi**, Nyshi, **Singpho**, **Galo**, **Tagin**, **Apatani**, and others. There are **three sub-tribes** of the **Mishmi tribe**:** Idu-Mishmi**, **Digaru-Mishmi**, and **Miju-Mishmi**.
